entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
I want to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little over two weeks ago and it's completely useless.
Thank you for calling, I understand you want to return a VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's order #VF12345. And hurry up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. I see your order here. You purchased the VeloBand Pulse on July 10th. Can you tell me what issues you are experiencing with the smart watch?

The Pulse doesn't track my heart rate properly! It's constantly giving me inaccurate readings. It’s supposed to be a fitness tracker, but it’s totally useless. It's going back. What is your return policy?
I understand your frustration. Our return policy allows for a full refund within 90 days of purchase. Since it's been just over two weeks, you are well within that window.
Ninety days? Really? Finally, some good news. So how do I return it?

I can process the return for you now. I will email you a prepaid shipping label. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the returned item, we will process the refund back to your original payment method. You should see it within 7-10 business days.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. Just send the label already. This whole experience has been a waste of time.

Absolutely. Please allow me a moment to generate the shipping label. Just to confirm, the email address associated with the order is correct? And I want to mention, we do have resources online that might help you troubleshoot the accuracy of the VeloBand Pulse. Sometimes a simple adjustment to the fit can make a difference. However, I will, of course, process the return according to our return policy if that is your preference.
Just send the stupid label! I tried everything already! It doesn’t work! I already know about your pathetic return policy. I wasted a bunch of money on this piece of garbage!

I understand your frustration. I have just sent the return shipping label to your email address. Please check your inbox and spam folder. Is there anything else I can assist you with today regarding this VeloBand Pulse or any other VeloFit product?
No. Just get me my money back. Now. I don’t have time for this nonsense. I want to speak to your manager!

I understand you would like to speak to a manager, however, all of our supervisors are currently assisting other customers. I assure you, I have processed your return and you will receive your refund as soon as we receive the returned product. The 90 days applies to the return so you are not outside of it.
Unbelievable. You people are completely useless!

I am very sorry you feel that way. I have done everything I can to assist you with your return today. Again, the email with the return label has been sent. Please let us know if you need anything further. I can also send you the link to our website and our support articles regarding the smart watch.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
